summary: Neff Gaming addresses members of the Child of Chaos faction during the Nightveil Standoff event, where Order of Reversal is trailing behind Nightsworn Vanguard. He urges players to participate in Magic Chess during its two daily time windows to boost contribution points. Additionally, he explains how creator reputation points are earned, highlighting that watching eligible content accounts for 50% of reputation. He suggests leaving his dedicated YouTube playlist running on mute in the background to help increase the faction's standings.
tips: Play Magic Chess during the two available daily time windows to earn maximum contribution points for the Order of Reversal.
Ensure creator binding with your chosen creator is completed to claim the 10,000 Reputation point bonus.
Open the creator's eligible content playlist, mute the audio, and let it play in the background to generate views and earn reputation points continuously.
title: A Critical Message for Child of Chaos Faction: How We Turn Things Around | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
